# Parent Email Template

Fill in the blanks yourself, in your email program. Never paste student names or grades into an AI tool.

## Before you paste anything into AI

- [ ] No student names
- [ ] No grades or scores
- [ ] No identifying details about individual students

## Email draft

**To:** Parent/Guardian __________________________________

**Subject:** ______________________________________________

**Body:**

Dear ______________________,

________________________________________________________________________

________________________________________________________________________

________________________________________________________________________

Please ________________________________________________________________
by __________________ (date).

Thank you,

__________________________________________
Teacher name

__________________________________________
School / grade

## After AI drafts it (optional)

- [ ] Read it out loud
- [ ] Check dates and times
- [ ] Fill in placeholders yourself
- [ ] Send from your school email

Published by **Asdale Dynamics, LLC**. Do not include student names or grades.
